achievements.name: Wake in Artaria
achievements.detail: Get through the opening on ZDR and start exploring Artaria.

achievements.name: E.M.M.I. Down
achievements.detail: Destroy an E.M.M.I. with the Omega Cannon.

achievements.name: Defeat Corpius
achievements.detail: Defeat Corpius and claim the Phantom Cloak.

achievements.name: Morph Ball
achievements.detail: Reclaim the Morph Ball in Cataris and roll through a tunnel too narrow to walk.

achievements.name: Varia Suit
achievements.detail: Take the Varia Suit and cross a superheated room without the heat draining you.

achievements.name: Shinespark
achievements.detail: Charge the Speed Booster, store it, and release a Shinespark.

achievements.name: Gravity Suit
achievements.detail: Find the Gravity Suit in Burenia and move freely underwater.

achievements.name: Screw Attack
achievements.detail: Obtain the Screw Attack and smash blocks that break only under that jump.

achievements.name: Every E.M.M.I.
achievements.detail: Destroy all seven E.M.M.I. units on ZDR.

achievements.name: Full Items
achievements.detail: Collect every pickup tracked on the map until the item percentage reads 100.

achievements.name: Mission Complete
achievements.detail: See Samus's mission on ZDR through to its end.
